real_defects.issue: parseScale read a metric scale with a thousands separator (1:1,000, 1:2,500, 1:1.000) as 1, 2.5 and 1: a site plan measured 1000x short
parseFeetInches applied a negative sign to the feet only: -3' 6" read as -30 in, not -42
a zero denominator gave a zero or infinite value: parseScale('1 1/0" = 1\'-0"') ratio 0, parseFeetInches('1/0"') Infinity
parseScale('1" = 0\'') returned ratio 0 (an engineering scale of zero feet), found by the new property test
